title: Snoc equivalence evaluation
statement: For a natural number $n$, a type $\Omega$, and a pair consisting of a function from the first $n$ indices to $\Omega$ and an element of $\Omega$, the equivalence with functions on $n+1$ indices sends the pair to the function obtained by appending that element as the last value.
